note: Roast pork belly cubes glazed with hoisin and honey, quick pickled cucumber

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to serve

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Toss the pork in the hoisin, honey and five spice.
Roast, glazing twice, until sticky and cooked through.
Quick pickle the cucumber in the vinegar.
Serve the pork on toothpicks with the cucumber.

note: Steamed beef and ginger dumplings with a roasted tomato chili dip

dish.n: Himalayan beef momo with tomato achar
dish.make_ahead: Cook straight after filling

ingredients.item: clove of garlic, for the achar

steps.text: Mix the mince, onion, garlic, ginger and coriander.
Fill the dumpling wrappers and pleat closed.
Steam in batches.
Blitz the roasted tomatoes with the chilli and garlic for achar.

note: Cream cheese fingers with cucumber or salmon and dill, crusts off

dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours ahead, cover with damp paper

steps.text: Spread the bread with cream cheese.
Fill half with cucumber and half with smoked salmon and dill.
Cut off the crusts and cut into neat fingers.
Lay on a silver tray.

note: Double-fried crispy wings in a sticky gochujang, honey and soy glaze

dish.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Toss the wings in the potato starch.
Fry at 160C, then rest.
Simmer the gochujang, honey, soy and garlic until glossy.
Fry again at 190C until crisp.
Toss in the sauce and top with sesame.

note: Puff pastry rolls filled with pizza sauce, pepperoni and mozzarella

dish.make_ahead: Rolls can be filled a day ahead, bake fresh

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C and line trays. Cut each pastry sheet into 8 rectangles.
Top each with pizza sauce, pepperoni, mozzarella and oregano.
Roll up, pinch the ends closed and lay seam down on the trays.
Brush with egg, scatter with parmesan and bake until puffed and golden.
Warm the napoli sauce with the honey and chilli flakes for dipping.

note: Baked wings tossed in a sticky blackberry, soy, honey and chili glaze

dish.make_ahead: Wings can dry in the fridge overnight

steps.text: Dry the wings uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Bake at 220C until crisp.
Simmer the blackberries with the soy, honey, garlic and chilli until sticky, then strain.
Toss the wings through the glaze.

note: Pork, onion and carrot sausage rolls with sesame, tomato sauce for dipping

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to crisp

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C and line a tray.
Mix the sausage mince with the onion, carrot and herbs.
Roll in the pastry sheets, egg wash and sprinkle with sesame.
Cut into 16 pieces.
Bake until golden and serve warm with tomato sauce.

note: Chili-braised beef chuck in corn tortillas with onion, cilantro and lime

dish.make_ahead: Meat up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Soak the chillies and blend with the garlic and cumin.
Braise the beef in the chilli paste until it shreds.
Shred the beef and warm the tortillas.
Serve in the tortillas with onion, coriander and lime.

note: Beef, potato and onion in crimped shortcrust, English mustard on the side

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to serve

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Mix the mince, potato, onion and pepper.
Cut the pastry into rounds, fill and fold into half moons.
Crimp, egg wash and bake.
Serve with English mustard.

note: Poached chicken, celery and chives in mayo on soft buttered rolls

dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Poach the chicken in simmering salted water, then cool and shred.
Mix with the mayonnaise, celery, chives, lemon juice and seasoning.
Split and butter the rolls and fill with lettuce and chicken salad.
Toss the apple in lemon and pack in a basket with the strawberries.

note: Hard shells with spiced beef, shredded lettuce, cheddar and tomato

dish.make_ahead: Best served warm

steps.text: Brown the mince with the cumin and taco spices.
Warm the taco shells.
Shred the lettuce and dice the tomato.
Fill the shells and lay them out.

note: Rolled corn tortillas filled with shredded chicken, cheddar and salsa, baked crisp

dish.make_ahead: Rolled taquitos up to 1 day ahead, bake fresh

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Mix the chicken, cheddar and salsa.
Warm the tortillas so they stay pliable.
Roll a spoonful tightly in each tortilla.
Brush with oil and bake seam side down until crisp.
Serve with sour cream.

note: Bite-size beef pies in shortcrust with a thick gravy filling

dish.n: Talent quest party pies and sauce
dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to serve

steps.text: Brown the mince and onion, stir in the flour, Worcestershire, tomato sauce and stock and simmer until thick.
Cool the filling.
Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 24 rounds from the shortcrust and press into mini muffin tins.
Fill, top with rounds of puff pastry, pinch the edges and brush with egg.
Bake until golden and serve hot with tomato sauce.

note: Lemon garlic lamb grilled and wrapped in pita with tomato, onion and garlic yogurt

dish.make_ahead: Best served warm

ingredients.item: clove of garlic, for the yoghurt

steps.text: Marinate the lamb in the lemon juice, garlic, oregano and oil.
Mix the yoghurt with the garlic.
Grill the lamb on high until charred.
Wrap small pieces in warm pita with tomato, onion and garlic yoghurt.
Pin with toothpicks.

note: Slow-braised beef pies with a puff pastry lid, tomato sauce on the side

dish.make_ahead: Filling up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Braise the beef in the stock and Worcestershire sauce until tender.
Thicken with the flour and cool.
Line pie tins with shortcrust and fill with the beef.
Top with puff pastry lids and brush with egg.
Bake at 200C and serve with tomato sauce.

note: Rye bites with lemon creme fraiche, smoked salmon, capers and dill

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Butter the rye and cut into small pieces.
Whip the creme fraiche with the lemon zest.
Top each piece with smoked salmon, a spoon of cream, capers and dill.
Finish with black pepper.

note: Sliced corned beef, hot mustard and mustard pickles on buttered white bread

dish.make_ahead: Beef cooked a day ahead, sandwiches made fresh

steps.text: Simmer the silverside with the onion and peppercorns.
Cool the beef in its liquid.
Slice thinly.
Butter the bread and pile on the beef with mustard and mustard pickles.
Cut into triangles.

note: Fresh shucked oysters on ice with shallot vinegar and lemon

dish.make_ahead: Mignonette up to 1 day, shuck oysters just before serving

steps.text: Mix the shallots, vinegar and pepper for the mignonette and rest.
Shuck the oysters.
Lay the oysters on crushed ice with lemon wedges and the mignonette alongside.

note: Smoked salmon blinis, shrimp cocktail shots and prosciutto-wrapped asparagus

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Top the blinis with creme fraiche and smoked salmon.
Toss the prawns in mayonnaise mixed with tomato sauce and spoon into shot glasses.
Blanch the asparagus for a minute.
Wrap in prosciutto.
Arrange everything on platters.

note: Twice-fried fries tossed in chicken salt, hot gravy for dipping

dish.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Rinse and dry the chips well.
Fry at 140C until soft, then drain and rest.
Fry again at 190C until golden and crisp.
Toss in chicken salt and serve with gravy for dipping.
Mix the salt and chilli powder on a plate.
Rub the rims of 4 pot glasses with lime and dip in the salt.
Add ice, lime juice, tomato juice, Worcestershire and hot sauce to each glass.
Top slowly with lager, stir once and add a lime wedge.

note: Pork sausage rolls with grated onion and carrot, served hot with tomato sauce

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to crisp

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C and line a tray.
Mix the sausage mince, onion and carrot.
Lay the filling along the edge of the pastry, roll up and seal.
Brush with egg, cut into pieces and bake.
Serve hot with tomato sauce.

note: Garlic and chili squid grilled hot and fast, finished with lime and cilantro

dish.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Score the squid and cut into pieces.
Toss with the oil, garlic, chilli and salt.
Grill on a very hot barbecue for a minute a side.
Finish with lime juice and coriander.

note: Sponge cubes dipped in raspberry jelly and rolled in coconut

dish.make_ahead: Make the day before

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180C and line a square tin. Beat the butter and sugar, add the eggs, then fold in the flour and milk.
Bake the sponge and cool overnight.
Make up the jelly and chill until just starting to set.
Cut the sponge into cubes, dip in the jelly and roll in coconut.
Chill until firm.

note: Lager-battered flathead with thick twice-fried chips, wrapped to go

dish.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Fry the chips at 140C until soft and drain.
Whisk the flour with the cold lager to a thin batter.
Dip the fish in flour, then batter, and fry at 180C.
Fry the chips again until crisp.
Wrap it all in paper with lemon and tartare.

note: Beef pie sitting on a bowl of buttery crushed peas

dish.make_ahead: Filling up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Braise the beef in the stock until tender.
Thicken with the flour and cool.
Line pie tins with shortcrust, fill and top with puff lids.
Brush with egg and bake at 200C.
Cook the peas and mash roughly with the butter.
Spoon peas into bowls, sit a pie on top and finish with tomato sauce.

note: Beef jerky marinated in soy, Worcestershire and smoked paprika, dried overnight

dish.make_ahead: Marinate overnight, keeps 2 weeks

steps.text: Slice the partly frozen beef very thin.
Mix the soy, Worcestershire, pepper and paprika and add the beef.
Marinate overnight in the fridge.
Lay on racks and dry at 70C.

note: Fried cornmeal cakes made with bacon fat, eaten warm with butter

dish.make_ahead: Best served warm

steps.text: Fry the bacon for its fat and keep the fat.
Mix the cornmeal and salt with some of the fat and the boiling water.
Shape into small ovals.
Fry in a cast iron pan until crisp and eat warm with butter.

film: Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid (1969)
note: Ham, sharp cheddar, green apple and cornichons with mustard butter, pressed

dish.n: Etta's ham and cheddar picnic baguettes
dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Split the baguettes lengthways and cut each in half.
Spread with butter and mustard.
Layer with the ham, cheddar, apple and cornichons.
Press closed, wrap tightly in baking paper and tie with string.

note: Cheddar and cream cheese ball with jalapeño, rolled in bacon and pretzel crumbs

dish.n: Link's ice block cheddar cheese ball
dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Beat the cream cheese, cheddar, jalapeno, paprika and Worcestershire sauce.
Shape into a ball, wrap and chill.
Fry the bacon until crisp and crumble with the pretzels and chives.
Roll the ball in the crumb.
Serve on a plate of crushed ice with crackers.

note: Smoky paprika drumsticks roasted until sticky with barbecue sauce

dish.make_ahead: Best served warm

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Rub the drumsticks with the paprika, garlic powder and sugar.
Roast the drumsticks.
Brush with barbecue sauce and roast until sticky.

note: Warm rolls with roast turkey, brie, cranberry sauce and spinach

dish.n: Polar Express turkey and cranberry rolls
dish.make_ahead: Assemble up to 1 day ahead, warm to serve

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180C. Split the rolls and spread the bases with cranberry sauce.
Layer with turkey, brie and spinach and close.
Wrap each in foil and warm until the cheese softens.
Unwrap and rewrap in baking paper with a paper ticket tucked in.

note: Green marshmallow corn flake wreaths with red candy berries

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, airtight

steps.text: Melt the butter and marshmallows with the green colouring.
Stir through the corn flakes until coated.
Shape spoonfuls into little wreaths on baking paper.
Press on red lollies as berries.
Set.

note: Pan-fried crab cakes with Dijon and breadcrumbs, golden on both sides

dish.make_ahead: Cakes can be chilled up to 4 hours

steps.text: Mix the crab with the mayonnaise, egg, mustard, paprika and breadcrumbs.
Shape into 8 small cakes.
Chill.
Pan fry in butter until golden on both sides.
Serve with lemon and tartare.

note: Prunes stuffed with blue cheese, wrapped in bacon and baked crisp

dish.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Stuff each prune with a small piece of blue cheese.
Wrap each in half a rasher of bacon and secure with a toothpick.
Bake until the bacon is crisp.

note: Sparkling wine jelly set in coupes over raspberries

dish.make_ahead: Make the day before

steps.text: Soak the gelatine in cold water.
Warm the water with the sugar, squeeze the gelatine and stir in to dissolve.
Cool slightly, then gently stir in the sparkling wine.
Pour into coupes over raspberries.
Chill.

note: Slow-roasted chili pork crisped in a pan, with pineapple, onion and cilantro

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep the pork chilled

ingredients.item: fresh pineapple, plus extra to serve

steps.text: Soak the dried chillies in hot water, then blitz with orange juice, some pineapple and garlic to a smooth marinade.
Coat the pork in the marinade, season and rub in well.
Roast the pork covered at 160C until it pulls apart.
Shred or slice the pork and crisp it in a very hot pan.
Warm the tortillas and serve with diced pineapple, onion and coriander.
Mix the salt and chilli powder on a plate.
Run a lime wedge around four tall glasses and dip the rims in the chilli salt.
Fill the glasses with ice.
Add lime juice, tomato juice, hot sauce and Worcestershire sauce to each glass.
Top with cold lager, stir once and garnish with a lime wedge.

note: Oven-puffed pork crackling dusted with chili salt and lime zest

dish.make_ahead: Dry overnight, then up to 1 day airtight

steps.text: Score the pork rind and rub with salt.
Dry the rind uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Roast at 240C until puffed and crackling.
Break up and dust with flaky salt mixed with chilli powder and lime zest.

note: Fried beef and potato empanadas with a green cilantro sauce

dish.make_ahead: Fill a day ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Fry the mince with the potato and cumin until cooked through.
Cool the filling completely.
Mix the arepa flour with warm water and salt to a dough.
Flatten balls of dough, fill, fold and crimp the edges.
Fry at 180C until crisp and golden.
Blitz coriander, chilli, lime and a little oil for the sauce.

note: Fresh lime jelly set in a mold, with chilled coconut cream and mint

dish.make_ahead: Make the day before, keep chilled

steps.text: Soak the gelatine leaves in cold water.
Heat the water with the sugar until dissolved.
Squeeze the gelatine and stir it in, then add the lime juice.
Pour into a mould.
Set in the fridge.
Turn out and serve with chilled coconut cream and mint.

note: Red wine chorizo, Manchego with quince paste, warm olives with orange peel

steps.text: Slice the chorizo and fry until crisp.
Add a splash of red wine and cook until sticky.
Cut the Manchego into triangles and top each with a sliver of quince paste.
Warm the olives with strips of orange peel.
Serve everything on small plates.

note: Potato, chorizo and soft scrambled egg in flour tortillas with red salsa

steps.text: Dice the potatoes and fry in oil until crisp.
Add the sliced chorizo and cook through.
Scramble the eggs softly and fold through.
Chop tomato, onion and chilli for a quick red salsa.
Warm the tortillas, fill with the mix and cheddar and top with the salsa.

note: Chopped shrimp in chilled tomato lime broth with avocado, crackers on the side

dish.make_ahead: Chill up to 4 hours

steps.text: Chop the prawns and dice the avocado and onion.
Mix with tomato juice, lime juice, coriander and hot sauce.
Chill for 30 minutes.
Spoon into glasses with crackers on the side.

note: Chopped grilled skirt steak in corn tortillas with tomatillo salsa verde

steps.text: Grill the steak over high heat.
Rest, then chop finely.
Blend charred tomatillos with coriander, lime and a little onion for a sharp salsa verde.
Warm the tortillas and pile in the steak with diced onion, coriander and salsa.

note: Crispy baked wings tossed in honey barbecue sauce with a splash of hot sauce

dish.make_ahead: Dry the wings the day before

steps.text: Leave the wings uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Toss with garlic powder and salt.
Bake at 220C until crisp.
Warm the barbecue sauce with honey and hot sauce.
Toss the wings through the sauce and serve with plenty of napkins.

note: ham, no burger, fixed

dish.make_ahead: Shape the patties up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Shape the mince into 12 small patties and season well.
Cook on a hot pan for about 2 minutes a side.
Brown folded ham slices in the pan, top each patty with ham and half a cheese slice, and cover for a minute to melt.
Put in the slider buns with pickles.

note: Baked wings in hot butter sauce with celery sticks and blue cheese dip

dish.make_ahead: Dry the wings the day before

steps.text: Dry the wings uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Bake at 220C until crisp.
Melt the hot sauce with the butter and honey.
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream for the dip.
Toss the wings in the sauce and serve with celery sticks and the dip.

note: Salami, ham and provolone with lettuce, tomato and red wine vinegar, sliced thick

steps.text: Split the loaf lengthways.
Layer with salami, ham, provolone, shredded lettuce, sliced tomato and onion.
Drizzle with oil and vinegar and season.
Press under a board, then cut into thick slices.

note: Slow-grilled hot sausage slices on toothpicks with mustard and pickled jalapeños

steps.text: Grill the sausages slowly over medium coals, turning often, until the skins blister and they are hot right through.
Slice thickly on an angle and spear each piece with a toothpick.
Serve with mustard and pickled jalapenos.

note: Spiced beef tamales in corn husks, steamed soft, with hot sauce

dish.make_ahead: Make a day ahead, steam to reheat

steps.text: Soak the corn husks in hot water.
Brown the mince with the diced onion, chilli powder and cumin.
Beat the masa harina with lard, baking powder and warm stock to a soft dough.
Spread the dough on the husks, add the beef, and roll up.
Steam the tamales until the dough pulls away from the husk.
Serve with hot sauce.

note: Baked pork and beef meatballs in a sweet chili and grape jelly glaze

steps.text: Mix the mince with the egg, breadcrumbs, garlic and salt.
Roll into 30 small balls.
Bake on a lined tray at 200C until browned.
Simmer the sweet chilli sauce with the grape jelly in a wide pan until glossy.
Add the meatballs and turn until coated, then serve hot on toothpicks.

note: Smoked salmon and dill cream cheese rolled in tortillas and sliced

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day chilled

steps.text: Mix the cream cheese with chopped dill and lemon zest and spread over the tortillas.
Lay the smoked salmon over and roll up tightly.
Wrap and chill for 1 hour.
Slice into 2cm pinwheels.

note: Button mushrooms stuffed with bacon, garlic, breadcrumbs and parmesan

steps.text: Remove the stems from the mushrooms and chop the stems.
Fry the stems with diced bacon and crushed garlic.
Mix with breadcrumbs and parmesan.
Fill the caps.
Bake at 200C until golden.

note: Spiced ground beef in corn tortillas with lettuce, cheddar and salsa

steps.text: Dice the onion and garlic.
Brown the mince with the onion, garlic, cumin and chilli.
Shred the lettuce and warm the tortillas.
Fill with the beef, lettuce, cheddar and a spoon of salsa.

note: Thick fries under beef and bean chili and melted cheddar

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thick chips.
Brown the mince with chopped onion and chilli powder.
Add the kidney beans and a splash of water and simmer.
Fry the chips until soft, then fry again until crisp.
Spoon the chilli over, top with cheddar and grill to melt.

note: Crispy baked wings tossed in honey and hot sauce butter

dish.make_ahead: Dry the wings the day before

steps.text: Leave the wings uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Toss with garlic powder and salt.
Bake at 220C until crisp.
Melt the butter with honey and hot sauce.
Toss the wings through until glossy.

note: Steamed pork, shrimp and shiitake dumplings with chili oil

steps.text: Mix the pork, prawns, ginger, shiitake and soy.
Spoon into the wonton wrappers and pinch up the sides.
Steam until cooked through.
Serve with chilli oil.

note: Fish balls simmered in coconut curry sauce and served on skewers

dish.n: Kowloon Walled City curry fish balls

steps.text: Crush the garlic.
Fry the curry powder and garlic in oil.
Add the coconut milk, sugar and water and simmer.
Add the fish balls and simmer until hot through.
Thread onto skewers and spoon over the sauce.

note: Toasted rye topped with pastrami, sauerkraut and melted Swiss cheese

steps.text: Cut the rye into quarters and toast lightly at 200C.
Top each with folded pastrami, sauerkraut and a square of Swiss cheese.
Bake until melted.
Mix the mayonnaise with tomato sauce, horseradish and chopped pickle.
Dab on each bite and spear with a slice of dill pickle.

note: Pan-fried pork and garlic chive dumplings with black vinegar

steps.text: Mix the pork with chives, ginger and sesame oil.
Fill the wrappers and pleat.
Fry until crisp underneath.
Add water and steam under a lid.
Serve with black vinegar.

note: Chilled almond milk jelly cubes with lychees and mandarin segments

dish.make_ahead: Make the day before, keep chilled

steps.text: Soak the gelatine leaves in cold water.
Warm the milk with the sugar, then stir in the gelatine and almond extract.
Set in a tray for 3 hours.
Cut into cubes.
Serve in bowls with lychees and mandarin segments in their syrup.

note: Steamed pork and cabbage dumplings with black vinegar and chili oil

steps.text: Mix the pork with wombok, ginger and spring onions.
Fill the wrappers and pleat.
Steam in bamboo baskets.
Serve with black vinegar and chilli oil.

note: Cumin and chili lamb skewers grilled until charred at the edges

ingredients.item: cumin seeds, crushed, plus extra to serve

steps.text: Toss the lamb with cumin, chilli flakes and salt.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill hot until charred at the edges.
Sprinkle with more cumin to serve.

note: Steamed pork and shrimp dumplings with soy and black vinegar

steps.text: Mix the pork, prawns, ginger and spring onion.
Fill the wrappers and pleat.
Steam until cooked through.
Serve with soy and black vinegar.

note: Chilled almond milk jelly cut in diamonds over lychees

dish.make_ahead: Make the day before, keep chilled

steps.text: Soak the gelatine in the water.
Heat the milk with the sugar, stir in the gelatine until dissolved and add the almond extract.
Set in a shallow dish for 3 hours.
Cut into diamonds.
Serve over the lychees with their syrup.

note: Cucumber and ham with English mustard on white bread, crusts off

steps.text: Butter the bread.
Fill half with thin cucumber.
Fill the rest with ham and English mustard.
Cut off the crusts and cut into triangles.

note: Bacon cornbread baked in a hot skillet

steps.text: Fry the bacon until crisp, chop and keep the fat in the pan.
Mix the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, egg and buttermilk.
Stir in the bacon.
Pour into the hot greased pan and bake at 220C.
Serve with butter.

note: Foil-baked brisket shredded in barbecue sauce on slider buns, with slaw

dish.n: Curly's one-thing brisket sliders with slaw
dish.make_ahead: Brisket up to 2 days chilled

steps.text: Rub the brisket with paprika, brown sugar, garlic powder and salt.
Wrap tightly in foil.
Bake at 150C until it pulls apart.
Shred with two forks and stir through the barbecue sauce and juices.
Toss the cabbage with mayonnaise and vinegar.
Fill the buns with brisket and slaw.

note: Mini bagels with cream cheese, smoked salmon, capers and dill

steps.text: Split and toast the bagels.
Spread with cream cheese.
Top with smoked salmon, capers, thin red onion and dill.

note: Toasted marshmallow and milk chocolate between digestive cookies

steps.text: Toast the marshmallows on sticks over the fire until blistered.
Sandwich each with a square of milk chocolate between 2 biscuits and press so it melts.

note: Jalapeños stuffed with cream cheese and cheddar, wrapped in bacon and baked

steps.text: Halve the jalapenos lengthways and scrape out the seeds.
Beat the cream cheese with cheddar and paprika and pack into the halves.
Wrap each in half a rasher of bacon and pin with a toothpick.
Bake on a rack at 200C until the bacon is crisp.
Mix the sour cream with chives, garlic powder and lemon juice for a dip.

note: Fried pork roll, fried egg and American cheese on a soft roll

steps.text: Cut the pork roll into 8 slices and nick the edges.
Fry until they curl and brown.
Fry the eggs.
Stack the pork, eggs and cheese into the rolls.
Wrap in foil to melt the cheese.
